svg.aria-label: Two deltas of length 1, each 40 degrees from their mean direction, merged two ways with equal weights. The weighted mean cancels their sideways parts and has length 0.77, shorter than either delta. RDA averages the lengths and the directions separately and gives the mean direction the mean length, 1.

text.tspan: . The parts of the deltas that disagree cancel,

svg.text: so the merged step is shorter than either of them.
Average the lengths and the directions separately, then give
the mean direction the mean length.
Two deltas of length 1, 40° either side of their mean direction, equal weights. GradientMail merges most tensors with RDA and names containing “embed” with the weighted mean.
